correctness.rationale: For normalized Fock basis e_k=z^k/sqrt(k!), A_{h,j} shifts e_k to e_{k+2h} with weight product_(u=1)^h(k-j+u)/sqrt(product_(u=1)^(2h)(k+u)), vanishing when k<j. For fixed indices weights tend to 1, so individual operators are bounded noncompact. Their commutator is a one-diagonal shift with d(k)=w2(k)w1(k+2h2)-w1(k)w2(k+2h1), hence its singular multiset is |d(k)|. Log-weight coefficients alpha=-h(h+2j)/2 and beta=h(2h²+2hj+h-2j²+2j)/4 yield nonresonant coefficient h1h2(lambda1-lambda2) at k^-2; under lambda equality the k^-2 term cancels and k^-3 coefficient is -(h1h2/2)(h1²-h2²), nonzero for distinct pairs because equal lambda and h imply equal j. Sorting tails with positive C proves s_n~Cn^-r, strong/weak Schatten thresholds p>1/r and log residue C^(1/r). Inspected actual CHECK.py exact finite identities and performed independent symbolic log-weight coefficient/parameter checks; finite testing is not used to establish the all-parameter asymptotic.

limitations: This is one-variable Gaussian Fock space, integer indices h>=1,j>=0 and fixed pairwise commutators; no general polynomial symbol, multiple nested commutator, or other Fock–Sobolev weight theorem.
